query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_wikidata,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pubchem_cid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_pubchem,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chebi_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_chebi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cas_number IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_cas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN iupac_name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_iupac,
  SUM(CASE WHEN smiles IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_smiles,
  SUM(CASE WHEN inchi_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_inchi
FROM molecules;
